exposure: Immediate labor induction after successful external cephalic version (ECV)
cohort: Women who underwent successful ECV performed in term singleton gestations (2007-2018) at the Rabin Medical Center
finding: Immediate labor induction after successful ECV did not improve the chances of vaginal delivery or reduce the risk of cesarean birth compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between groups, with no significant difference in cesarean birth rates.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was lower in the immediate induction group (3128 vs 3346 g, P < .01)
